Company exposure requirements企业敞口要求

Company exposure is not inferred from the listing or the currency channel.企业敞口不由上市身份或汇率通道推断。

  • Issuer identity发行人身份
  • Revenue currency收入货币
  • Cost currency成本货币
  • Debt currency债务货币
  • Hedges对冲
  • Effective date生效日期
Company exposure requirements企业敞口要求

Issuer identity, revenue currency, cost currency, debt currency, hedges and effective date are required before any company exposure claim.在作出任何企业敞口陈述之前，需要发行人身份、收入货币、成本货币、债务货币、对冲和生效日期。

Retained research保留研究

  • Emerging-market stress新兴市场压力

    A coincident EM origin aggregate. It is not a country diagnosis.这是新兴市场源点的同步聚合，不是单个国家的判断。

  • Transmission to the US向美国传导

    Signals from the existing US transmission model.来自现有美国传导模型的信号。

    Transmission assessment unavailable传导评估不可用

  • VAR/GFEVD statistical connectednessVAR/GFEVD 统计关联

    VAR/GFEVD statistical connectedness is not causality.VAR/GFEVD 统计关联不是因果关系。

  • Daily return correlation日回报相关性

    Daily return correlation is distinct from the weekly correlation matrix.日回报相关性与周回报矩阵不同。

  • Directed model pressure有向模型压力

    Directed model pressure is not issuer exposure.有向模型压力不是发行人敞口。

  • Structural fragility结构性脆弱

    Slow-moving country balance-sheet indicators; not crisis timing or issuer exposure.变化缓慢的国家资产负债指标；不能确定危机时点或企业敞口。

Retained research保留研究

  • Emerging-market stress新兴市场压力

    A coincident EM origin aggregate. It is not a country diagnosis.这是新兴市场源点的同步聚合，不是单个国家的判断。

  • Transmission to the US向美国传导

    Signals from the existing US transmission model.来自现有美国传导模型的信号。

    Transmission assessment unavailable传导评估不可用

  • VAR/GFEVD statistical connectednessVAR/GFEVD 统计关联

    VAR/GFEVD statistical connectedness is not causality.VAR/GFEVD 统计关联不是因果关系。

  • Daily return correlation日回报相关性

    Daily return correlation is distinct from the weekly correlation matrix.日回报相关性与周回报矩阵不同。

  • Directed model pressure有向模型压力

    Directed model pressure is not issuer exposure.有向模型压力不是发行人敞口。

  • Structural fragility结构性脆弱

    Slow-moving country balance-sheet indicators; not crisis timing or issuer exposure.变化缓慢的国家资产负债指标；不能确定危机时点或企业敞口。

Company exposure requirements企业敞口要求

Company exposure is not inferred from the listing or the currency channel.企业敞口不由上市身份或汇率通道推断。

  • Issuer identity发行人身份
  • Revenue currency收入货币
  • Cost currency成本货币
  • Debt currency债务货币
  • Hedges对冲
  • Effective date生效日期
Company exposure requirements企业敞口要求

Issuer identity, revenue currency, cost currency, debt currency, hedges and effective date are required before any company exposure claim.在作出任何企业敞口陈述之前，需要发行人身份、收入货币、成本货币、债务货币、对冲和生效日期。

Fast pressure. Slow resilience.短期压力，长期韧性

Company exposure requirements企业敞口要求

Company exposure is not inferred from the listing or the currency channel.企业敞口不由上市身份或汇率通道推断。

  • Revenue currency收入货币
  • Cost currency成本货币

Issuer identity, revenue currency, cost currency, debt currency, hedges and effective date are required before any company exposure claim.在作出任何企业敞口陈述之前，需要发行人身份、收入货币、成本货币、债务货币、对冲和生效日期。

Retained research保留研究

  • Emerging-market stress新兴市场压力

    A coincident EM origin aggregate. It is not a country diagnosis.这是新兴市场源点的同步聚合，不是单个国家的判断。

  • Transmission to the US向美国传导

    Signals from the existing US transmission model.来自现有美国传导模型的信号。

    Transmission assessment unavailable传导评估不可用

  • VAR/GFEVD statistical connectednessVAR/GFEVD 统计关联

    VAR/GFEVD statistical connectedness is not causality.VAR/GFEVD 统计关联不是因果关系。

  • Daily return correlation日回报相关性

    Daily return correlation is distinct from the weekly correlation matrix.日回报相关性与周回报矩阵不同。

  • Directed model pressure有向模型压力

    Directed model pressure is not issuer exposure.有向模型压力不是发行人敞口。

  • Structural fragility结构性脆弱

    Slow-moving country balance-sheet indicators; not crisis timing or issuer exposure.变化缓慢的国家资产负债指标；不能确定危机时点或企业敞口。

Company exposure requirements企业敞口要求

Company exposure is not inferred from the listing or the currency channel.企业敞口不由上市身份或汇率通道推断。

  • Issuer identity发行人身份
  • Revenue currency收入货币
  • Cost currency成本货币
  • Debt currency债务货币
  • Hedges对冲
  • Effective date生效日期
Company exposure requirements企业敞口要求

Issuer identity, revenue currency, cost currency, debt currency, hedges and effective date are required before any company exposure claim.在作出任何企业敞口陈述之前，需要发行人身份、收入货币、成本货币、债务货币、对冲和生效日期。

Retained research保留研究

  • Emerging-market stress新兴市场压力

    A coincident EM origin aggregate. It is not a country diagnosis.这是新兴市场源点的同步聚合，不是单个国家的判断。

  • Transmission to the US向美国传导

    Signals from the existing US transmission model.来自现有美国传导模型的信号。

    Transmission assessment unavailable传导评估不可用

  • VAR/GFEVD statistical connectednessVAR/GFEVD 统计关联

    VAR/GFEVD statistical connectedness is not causality.VAR/GFEVD 统计关联不是因果关系。

  • Daily return correlation日回报相关性

    Daily return correlation is distinct from the weekly correlation matrix.日回报相关性与周回报矩阵不同。

  • Directed model pressure有向模型压力

    Directed model pressure is not issuer exposure.有向模型压力不是发行人敞口。

  • Structural fragility结构性脆弱

    Slow-moving country balance-sheet indicators; not crisis timing or issuer exposure.变化缓慢的国家资产负债指标；不能确定危机时点或企业敞口。

Retained research保留研究

  • Emerging-market stress新兴市场压力

    A coincident EM origin aggregate. It is not a country diagnosis.这是新兴市场源点的同步聚合，不是单个国家的判断。

  • Transmission to the US向美国传导

    Signals from the existing US transmission model.来自现有美国传导模型的信号。

    Transmission assessment unavailable传导评估不可用

  • VAR/GFEVD statistical connectednessVAR/GFEVD 统计关联

    VAR/GFEVD statistical connectedness is not causality.VAR/GFEVD 统计关联不是因果关系。

  • Daily return correlation日回报相关性

    Daily return correlation is distinct from the weekly correlation matrix.日回报相关性与周回报矩阵不同。

  • Directed model pressure有向模型压力

    Directed model pressure is not issuer exposure.有向模型压力不是发行人敞口。

  • Structural fragility结构性脆弱

    Slow-moving country balance-sheet indicators; not crisis timing or issuer exposure.变化缓慢的国家资产负债指标；不能确定危机时点或企业敞口。

Company exposure requirements企业敞口要求

Company exposure is not inferred from the listing or the currency channel.企业敞口不由上市身份或汇率通道推断。

  • Issuer identity发行人身份
  • Revenue currency收入货币
  • Cost currency成本货币
  • Debt currency债务货币
  • Hedges对冲
  • Effective date生效日期
Company exposure requirements企业敞口要求

Issuer identity, revenue currency, cost currency, debt currency, hedges and effective date are required before any company exposure claim.在作出任何企业敞口陈述之前，需要发行人身份、收入货币、成本货币、债务货币、对冲和生效日期。

    Test your assumptions检验您的假设

    Enter returns over the selected horizon. These assumptions are not forecasts and do not update source history.输入所选区间内的回报。这些假设不是预测，也不会更新来源历史。

    Manual return assumptions手动回报假设

    Use a decimal point, for example 1.5. A positive currency return means the local currency strengthens against USD.使用小数点，例如 1.5。汇率回报为正表示本币相对美元升值。

    Review assumptions for the proposed context检查拟用范围的假设

    Your original context and calculation are retained. Review the inputs above before confirming; no return is annualized.原范围和计算结果已保留。确认前请检查上方输入；不会将回报年化。

    Clear these two assumptions?清除这两个假设？

    Market, horizon, pins and research history will be preserved.市场、区间、固定项及研究历史将保留。

    Enter both assumptions, then calculate.输入两个假设后计算。

    Conditional USD return条件美元回报

    FX contribution汇率贡献:

    Over the confirmed horizon · price return · unhedged已确认区间内 · 价格回报 · 未对冲

    Illustrative FX assumptions示例汇率假设

      These rows are illustrations, not a likely range or an optimized outcome.这些仅为示例，并非可能范围或最优结果。

      Calculation method计算方法

      USD return = (1 + local return) × (1 + currency return) − 1. FX contribution = (1 + local return) × currency return. Percent inputs are divided by 100 before calculation.美元回报 = (1 + 本币回报) × (1 + 汇率回报) − 1。汇率贡献 = (1 + 本币回报) × 汇率回报。计算前将百分比输入除以 100。

      A return quoted in local currency per USD requires reciprocal conversion; changing its sign is not sufficient.每美元兑本币的反向报价回报必须按倒数换算，不能仅改变正负号。

      Contagion board传导看板 ?How tightly are global markets linked right now? The score (0–100) measures how far a shock in one market travels to others, using a rolling 150-day window. Higher = shocks spread faster. Top shock senders are markets that export the most stress to peers. US receiving share = how much of international stress eventually reaches the S&P 500 — this is a transmission read, not a causal share. Source: daily ETF returns.全球市场目前关联程度如何？得分（0–100）衡量某市场冲击向其他市场的传导程度，使用150日滚动窗口。数值越高，冲击传播越快。前三大冲击输出方是最多向同伴输出压力的市场。美国接收份额 = 国际压力最终传导至标普500的比例——这是传导读数，非因果占比。数据来源：ETF日度收益。

      How connected are markets right now?市场间关联程度如何？

      / 100
      Moderate links between markets市场间关联程度适中
      Above 80: stress in any market can quickly reach others. Below 60: markets absorb their own shocks.超过80：任意市场的压力可快速蔓延。低于60：市场能消化自身冲击。
